title: Chemical extraction of sulfachloropyridazine from muscle samples
author: Ekaterina Pokrant

steps_raw.instruction: Weigh 5 ± 0.05 g of muscle sample in a 50-mL polypropylene tube.
Fortifie the samples with the internal standard solution Sulfamethazine-(phenyl-13C6) hemihydrate (SMZ-13C6) and the possitive controls with the analyte Sulfamethazine

steps_raw.title: Samples must be rested before extraction.
Stirr the sample on a vortex-mixer.
Add 15 µL of NaOH 1M to the mixture.
steps_raw.instruction: Sodium hydroxide Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #1064981000

steps_raw.title: Adjust the pH of the sample to 7.8 – 8.0 with 10% v/v HCl.
steps_raw.instruction: Hydrochloric acid fuming 37% Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #1003172500
To dissolve the resulting gel, shook gently the sample by hand and centrifuge it again at 2,790 g 00:10:00

Transferre the supernatant to a clean 50 mL polypropylene tube and repeat the extraction with 10 mL of Ethyl acetate two more times (step 10, 11, 12 and 13 until have 30 mL of extraction solvent in the new tube) Ethyl Acetate J.T. Baker Catalog #9280-03
Evaporate resulting supernatant using a water bath at 40-50°C under a mild nitrogen flow

Reconstitute the sample with 500 µL of a mixture of mobile phase A and B (15/85). Mobile phase A: 0.1% formic acid in methanol (pH 2.9 ± 0.3). Mobile phase B: 0.1% formic acid in water (pH 2.7 ± 0.2). Formic Acid 98-100% Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #100264 Methanol J.T. Baker Catalog #9093-03 Water Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #1153334000

steps_raw.title: Stirr on a vortex-mixer the reconstituted solution.

steps_raw.instruction: Transfer the reconstituted solution into an Eppendorf tube and centrifuged at 17,000 g 00:10:00
Filter the sample through 13 mm millex filters with 0.22 µm polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) membranes and transfer into a glass vials.
